title: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

sense.text:
“And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt”. The patriarchs are the fathers, Joseph’s own brothers. In the days of the Acts of the Apostles, under Rome, Stephen is quoting what happened way back in the time of Jacob and Joseph, because they read what was written aforetime. No new thing under the sun, as King Solomon said.

Envy moved them to conspire his murder, and the murder leads to lies to cover up the act: adding sin unto sin. They sold him into slavery, but it was all for a greater purpose: “but God was with him”. The same way we say God is with us. This movement in IUIC is not of man, it is of God. God is using the bishop, putting the wisdom and understanding upon him to set forth the things God put in place for a greater purpose. It is not to glorify men.

We do not want to stay here in Babylon. Waking up every day dreading two jobs, two damn jobs at the same time, just to make ends meet: some brothers enjoy their occupation and love working for Esau, but we hate it and despise it. That should make you increase your zeal to usher in the kingdom of Christ, not get up behind a camera and slander your brother, use AI to make stupid videos, call brothers gay that you have never had a conversation with, or get physical with brothers out of hatred. Who the hell has time for that? That is fighting against God, kicking against the pricks.

Envy caused Joseph’s brothers to persecute the very one God appointed to save them. We all believe in regeneration, and these other camps that hate our guts believe in it too, because it is scriptural. So you do not know who is who. The brother you are calling gay or slandering could be King David back on the earth, or Solomon, Samuel, Hezekiah, Zephaniah, Paul, Peter, John the Revelator. Those you hate could be the prophets of the Lord and you just do not know.

Walk in the fruits of the spirit now, or wait till Christ comes back and tells you that all this time you were slandering David, Zephaniah, Habakkuk. Then it is death: he will take your head clean off, your head on a stake like Ivan the Terrible, the so-called Dracula. And rightfully so, because the door of grace was open for you to repent, and you denied it and continued in that anger and envy.
The children of Israel “were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.”

“Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” This new Pharaoh knew not Joseph and his great works, and he feared that the children of Israel would take over because they multiplied. He feared that he and his people would become obsolete.
“Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply”. Those are the secret councils. Pharaoh conspired against the children of Israel the same way Joseph’s brothers conspired against Joseph.
The treasure cities “Pithom and Raamses” are the Valley of the Kings.

“But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew.” Same thing today in Babylon. They put all these stumbling blocks before the children of Israel to cause us to die, the school-to-prison pipeline and the rest, but we are still here and still multiplying.

That alone should let you know that these people are of God: I am doing everything in my power to destroy them, and I cannot destroy them. That is what Pharaoh was doing, and it is what Esau is doing today. But because of envy and hatred you cannot think straight, and you cannot see that these people are of God.
Pharaoh’s plot, to cast every son that is born into the river, was not successful, as we go over every Passover.

precepts.why:
“Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.” Persecution never stops us. Either we multiply, as Israel did under Pharaoh, or if we are scattered, it still causes God’s word to increase. It was the same in the time of the apostles: even scattered, it was for God’s purpose, to spread the word.

That is the faith we walk by: God is on our side no matter what. Whatever we face as a congregation or in our personal lives, it is for a reason, if we are doing right by him.

sense.text:
Samuel is speaking to Saul: “But now thy kingdom shall not continue”, because of disobedience. Saul was told to slay all of Amalek, and he spared Agag and some of the flocks. So God said: you are walking in disobedience, therefore I will replace you. You are going to become obsolete, and I will replace you with something greater to fulfil God’s purpose. “The Lord hath sought him a man after his own heart”.

The house of Saul is back here today; we see them on social media. You have the house of David and the house of Saul back on the earth. No new thing under the sun.

“Because thou hast not kept that which the Lord commanded thee”: not keeping his laws, defiling doctrine, coming up with your new understanding.
“Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.”

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft”. Rebellion and stubbornness are the characteristics Saul had. We talk about obeah and voodoo and know those are witchcraft, but being rebellious and kicking against the pricks is also counted as witchcraft. Same thing. “Because thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, he hath also rejected thee from being king.”

Saul became obsolete as God’s chosen, but he was not removed from his throne so quickly; it happened in the process of time. Right after this, instead of repenting and acknowledging his envy and hatred, he went to try to kill King David. He forgot everything God told Samuel to tell him, and was still moved with envy and hatred because he did not check it.

When that thing grows it is like a cancer, a tumour. It metastasized all over Saul’s spirit, and there was nothing he could do, even after speaking to Samuel and being checked by God. That is why envy and hatred are nothing to play with: it manifests itself in many of these congregations, these Black Hebrew Israelite camps.
“Seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel”, “for I have provided me a king among his sons.” King David was chosen while King Saul was still in power.

“Now he was ruddy”. Ruddy means no blemish: dark and lovely, like the beauty product they used to have in the stores. It means black. “And withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to”: a handsome young man. “Arise, anoint him: for this is he.”

“And the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward.” That is why David was able to do such great things, and why he is counted so mighty when we read the records of our forefathers, for the things written aforetime were written for our learning: the spirit of the Lord was on David. David went off a bit and committed his sin, but he repented shortly after and walked after God.

That is why thousands of years later, in 2026 in Babylon the Great, we can open our Constitution, the Bible, and read the great works of our forefather, the same way we read the evil works our forefathers did. So which side of the court do you want to play on, the evil side or the good side?

The book of Acts does not end with the word amen; it continues. The books in heaven we will be judged by are the Bible and another book of our works, being written right now as we speak. When they open it and get to your name, you do not want envy, hatred and malice written under it; you want those sins blotted out. These evil roaches that hate our sunlight, our light, if they do not get it together, are not getting the kingdom of heaven. Their name will be blotted out, and in their book will be nothing but slander, evil and hatred.

“But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord troubled him.” If the spirit of the Lord is not occupying your fleshly body, an evil spirit replaces it: demons, sometimes legions. The works of the flesh are demons. Envy, hatred, malice, guile, strife: demons. When the spirit of the Lord left Saul, an evil spirit entered into him.

“Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.” Even the servants knew Saul had the devil on him. Sometimes it takes others, whether they have rank in the congregation or not, to recognize the fault of the leaders, because men tend to go off.

That is why we look at many of these congregations and ask, does nobody check this? Nobody sees this man with a ball and chain in one hand and a cup of cognac in the other? Talking with a lisp and flicking his hair, the evil gay spirit on him, while he calls everybody else gay? Nobody sees the hatred on him, constantly talking about another man’s wife and the colour of our uniform? The servants of Saul saw it. The servants of Saul were better than some around today.

“Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.” The difference is only how many of the enemy were slain. Does it really matter if one kills a thousand and the other ten thousand? The enemies are still being put to death. Two men of the same nation, different tribes but the same people, the same blood and flesh, walking towards the mark with the same goal: destroy our enemies. You might kill fifty and I a hundred; we are both reaching the same goal.

Saul could not understand that David was sent to help him. Brothers cannot understand that we are on the same mission towards the kingdom of heaven. One congregation might have more fruits than another and reach more of the masses, but we are still reaching the masses. With envy and hatred you cannot see that. You become blind, moved with lust and power.

“They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands”. If you only killed a thousand, do you want them to lie? If you killed fifty, why would they say two hundred? They were telling the truth. Thou shalt not lie. “And what can he have more but the kingdom?” Now he is going to get the kingdom.
“And Saul eyed David from that day and forward”, with an evil eye.

“And Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him”. That is the reason. The envy and hatred came out of fear, because the spirit of the Lord was with King David. The same way the Lord is with us if we continue to walk in the blueprint. And the blueprint is simple: keep the commandments and do the work. Have a zeal for the work. That is it.

Saul spake “that they should kill David.” That is what happens when you do not check that hatred, that envy, that lust for power: it turns into wanting to murder somebody. Now you want to shoot somebody, stab somebody, do secret drive-bys.
“But he slipped away out of Saul’s presence”, because God was preserving King David.

Saul sent messengers “to watch him, and to slay him in the morning”, and Michal let David down through a window. The spirit of the Lord was preserving King David, and the spirit of the devil, of Satan, was moving King Saul to keep persecuting him.

“That all of you have conspired against me”. Saul became so desperate that he took loyalty to David as betrayal of himself, because he wanted everybody against King David. We see the same today: people put out slander to turn whole congregations to hate a man they have never seen.

Bishop Nathanyel never sat down with these brothers or broke bread with them. They were not at the old One West with the Bishop. These are new, Johnny-come-lately brothers, fresh out of the Pamper. They hate a man they have not sat with; they do not know his history; they know nothing. But because of hatred, they do what they do.
Ahimelech answered for David: “who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?”

Doeg the Edomite “fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod”, because they showed affinity to David.

This is why we read it. A couple of years ago there was a video of a brother who was not with IUIC; he just happened to be wearing purple. Because we live rent-free in the minds of many of these brothers in other congregations, they assumed he was with us, and before he could even ask a question they said: oh, you must be with them purple niggers. It is the same thing as here. When you move with that spirit, that is what happens.

“And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword”. Saul accused Ahimelech and the priests of conspiracy, Doeg killed eighty-five priests, and the city of Nob was destroyed, all because of hatred and envy.

King David was not greater than Christ, and we are not greater than Christ either: “The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you”. We will be persecuted by our own kinsmen, and by the heathen as well. That is what Jacob’s trouble is about.

Many read this and think it is only the heathen, the Christians, the churches and their different denominations. It is that, but it is not limited to that. It is also talking about Black, dusty Hebrew Israelites.
“Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.” That is how close David got to him.

“The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord’s anointed”. After all the evil, David still called him his master. The same spirit that was in King David is the spirit we have to have. We have to make sure the hatred does not spread onto us, like the evil spirit in the movie Fallen with Denzel, going from man to man and causing them to murder.

We are not going to go tit for tat. Yes, we will call you out, as we are doing in this class, and shine a light on your wicked behind. But we are not going to make stupid videos or get physical with brothers, only in self-defence. We are not going to be like you. The house of David, which is in IUIC, is not going to become like the house of Saul.

“So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul.” These men were warriors, swordsmen; if they had wanted to they could have subdued Saul and his men. But King David took the bigger position: he was chosen before me. Saul was becoming obsolete, yet David still showed him respect.

Abishai: “now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.” These men were itching to get it on, with the weapon of choice in hand, and David had to hold back their hands.

“Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord’s anointed, and be guiltless?” The spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul and the evil spirit inhabited his body and mind, yet King David still understood: this man was chosen before me; who am I to touch him? Let God deal with him.

“The Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.” That is what happens when you walk in the spirit: “take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.”

So we read about Joseph, about Pharaoh, and about King David, and how hatred and anger can consume you. Saul did not want to accept the agony of defeat, although he was becoming obsolete.
Obadiah was scared to death of what was being done while Jezebel persecuted and slew the prophets: “What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?”

“When Jezebel slew the prophets of the Lord”. Jezebel was not merely trying to destroy one prophet. She was trying to stop the whole prophetic voice in Israel, the whole movement. Same thing today: when these videos and congregations speak against one specific person, their objective is to destroy this whole movement. Smite the shepherd and the flock shall flee. They do not hate the man, for they do not know him.

One of these camps said: we are trying to do this and that, but IUIC is in our way. To be in somebody’s way you have to be in front of them. So they acknowledge the works and the spirit of the Lord on the brothers in this organized nation. They see it and they despise it, because they cannot go around it or walk side by side with it. Instead of staying on pace and fulfilling their own course, they want us out of the way. Why, if we are all trying to get to the kingdom of heaven and wake up the elect of our brothers and sisters? It is that evil spirit that has not been repented of, the same spirit Jezebel displayed against the prophets.

“Art thou he that troubleth Israel?” Ahab tries to shift the blame onto the messenger for the consequences of his own disobedience. “I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.”

That is the avenue they often try: they say we teach doctrines that are not pure. It is not true. In Israel United in Christ we make sure we maintain doctrinal purity, and even the detestable heathen recognize that about us. They say: you teach one wife. Does not Christ say one wife in 1 Timothy?

Ahab told Jezebel “how he had slain all the prophets with the sword”, and she sent to Elijah: “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.” After God demonstrated his power on Mount Carmel, you would think Jezebel and the people would repent. Instead it increased her fury.

Same thing now. For the many mighty works the Most High, all praises to the Most High and his son, is allowing IUIC to do, instead of praise we get hatred. The miracles the Most High works in IUIC should increase the faith of these other camps, but they spew more hatred. We are in Africa, and they say there are no Israelites in Africa. Come on, stupid. You do not even believe that. Now one of their so-called mighty men is allegedly waking up and saying there are Israelites in Africa, when last month there were none. The works we do are supposed to bring them to repentance, so they see the kingdom is on its way. But they are moved with hatred, just like Jezebel.

Evidence does not always sway a hardened heart. It makes it worse, the same way it made Jezebel worse, and the same way it made the Pharisees worse with Christ when he raised Lazarus.

Many “believed on him. But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees”. They had seen that this man was dead and Christ raised him up. What the hell is going on here? What more do you need? Why are you still rejecting, still hating, still moved with disbelief?

You would think the mighty works the Most High allows Israel United in Christ to do would bring brothers to repentance: as much as we hate these guys, the spirit of the Lord is working with them, so let us fall in our place and stop the slander. No. They are consumed by it and must fulfil that evil lot, and if they continue in that footstep they will not get the kingdom of God. I don’t give a damn how many studs you put on your headband; they ain’t going to get you into the kingdom of God.

“If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him”. That was the fear. If we leave IUIC alone, they say, if we leave Bishop Nathanyel alone, all men will believe on him and follow him. But is it really us, or is it the spirit of the Lord moving these brothers and sisters to come into the congregation and repent? He is the one who gets the glory. “And the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation”: that was the fear of the Pharisees.

Caiaphas had some understanding: “it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.” He knew because the things written of old time were written for our learning. Christ comes in the volume of the book, prophesied to be the lamb to die for the nation.

“And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.” The Christian church cannot understand this, and it is where they get confused when they read words like Greeks and heathens in the New Testament. That nation is the southern kingdom: Judah, Benjamin and Levi. Those scattered abroad are the other tribes, to be gathered back into one fold. This was understood back then.

“There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the Lord”. If you want to inquire of God, this is the man you must go to, which means he is a prophet. They acknowledge the spirit of the Lord is on him. “But I hate him”: although the spirit of the Lord is on this man, I hate his stinking guts.

“For he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” He does not prophesy multiple wives, or that you do not have to wear fringes, or that you do not have to keep the Sabbath. He prophesies that you do have to keep the Sabbath, that you must have fringes on your garments, one wife as the Bible says. We hate you for that. Oh, you have one wife? Then you are gay. So Paul was a bottom man? Christ was a bottom man? They were not married. What do you have to say about that?

“And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.”
Zedekiah “smote Micaiah on the cheek”: Micaiah was that prophet.

“Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction”. They put him in prison because they did not like what he prophesied. They did not hate him for his actions; he had not committed adultery with a brother’s wife, hit a brother or stolen from a brother. They hated him because of the words of the Lord that came out of his mouth. Micaiah’s light shined on their darkness, and roaches are revealed when the light turns on. That is why they hate the way they hate.

Amaziah sent to Jeroboam, “Amos hath conspired against thee”, and told Amos to prophesy elsewhere, “for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.” Amaziah was more concerned with protecting the king’s institution than with hearing the word of the Lord.

“Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel”. It is the same today, because the things written aforetime were written for our learning. Instead of correcting the leaders and teachers in these congregations with their ridiculous doctrines and ridiculous accusations, they would prefer we not speak at all.

“Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah”. All through the scripture we have read how envy and hatred turned into murder, the physical. Here is the beginning step: “Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.” They start with accusations, lies and allegations from the mouth, because that is how anger and envy usually show themselves, in speech. Then the speech becomes physical.

Pashur heard “that Jeremiah prophesied these things. Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks”. Prophecy is not all love and kisses. We are supposed to prophesy destruction, so that our people may wake up, because that is what is going to happen: destruction is headed to America, to Babylon the Great. So we prophesy about them, as Jeremiah did.

“For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side.” “All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him”. They were watching Jeremiah and all his actions, waiting for him to fall, to make a mistake, so they could say: got you. Remember they did this? They got caught doing that? Plaster it all over social media and defame the whole organization. What was going on in Jeremiah’s time is happening today.
Irijah took Jeremiah, “saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans. Then said Jeremiah, It is false”. A false accusation. “But he hearkened not to him”: he would not listen.

“But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets”. It is the same in this time: the Israelite movement is being mocked. Many of our people in these days are coons for Babylon, and they mock the prophets of the Lord, not knowing that we really are the prophets of the Lord. What you get in Israel you will not get in the different denominations; all you will get there is washed-up white supremacist ideology.

“And cast thy law behind their backs”. That is our people today in the Christian church.

“And slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee”. We know the heathen are capable of that, but brothers in the faith, Israelites, should not move like that. If you move with that spirit, you are not in the faith. We should not have brothers who profess themselves Israelites moving with anger and hatred until they want to get physical with their brothers and possibly put them to death. That is something we have to check in ourselves. The spirit is there, and it will grow; do not be shocked.

“Ye build the tombs of the prophets”, “And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.” They say: if we had been around back then, we would not have been in cahoots with those other Israelites that killed the prophets. “Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.” The scriptures are twofold: Christ is saying they had regenerated to do the same thing again.

The same demons are back on the earth in 2026. Wherever we go they are on our coattail, and whatever we do that is good they look at as evil. They are stuck in their lot. They cannot move to the left or the right or go back; they have to keep going straight forward on that path of death, of envy and hatred. It is embedded in them, the same as with the Pharisees and scribes.

“Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?” Snakes, you damn devils. You cannot escape it because you are not going to repent. This is your lot. You are an envious, hateful bastard.

“Some of them ye shall kill and crucify”. You kill with words first, smite with the tongue, and then it becomes physical. “And persecute them from city to city”: they follow us from camp spot to camp spot, block to block, city to city, corner to corner.

“From the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.” They followed the man into the temple; they would probably have gone into the holy of holies to kill a brother. That is what happens when you are moved with hatred.

Our brother Stephen: “as your fathers did, so do ye. Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted?” Those same demons are back. Yes, they have fringes on, studs and headbands on, and they cannot shake that spirit of hatred. It is their lot until they die.

“When they heard these things”, just words. Stephen did not lay a hand on them or try to fight them. When he shined that light on their darkness, “they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.”
He saw “Jesus standing on the right hand of God”: Christ standing on the right hand of God.

“Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God”. We: it was more than just Nicodemus; there was Joseph of Arimathea, and other Pharisees. A plethora of Pharisees knew that Christ was of God, a teacher from God, the Messiah.

Some became secret followers of Christ, and many others, even though they knew, still went against him. They knew he was the anointed and that they would become obsolete, and the agony of defeat was killing them inside.

“Among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue”. We know this: brothers and sisters in some of these congregations see the evil going on, the evil spoken of our leadership. Some want to leave and speak on it, but because of fear they do not want to be put out.
“For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.” That is the point: men’s admiration, with advantage in mind, instead of the praise of God.
This is the parable of the wicked husbandmen: they “beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.”

The son is Christ, the heir; Christ is referring to himself. The husbandmen are the Pharisees. “But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir”. How did they know the son was the heir? They had to acknowledge the works of Christ and know that this man is the Messiah, as Nicodemus said, we know, and as Caiaphas prophesied. But they rejected him: “come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.”

“He will miserably destroy those wicked men”. Christ could engage the Pharisees in conversation and have them answer back, talking about themselves without realizing it, until maybe a mile down the road they realize they are bleeding all over the place: damn, this dude was cutting us, he was talking about us.
“The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner”.

precepts.why:
Some of these Black Hebrew Israelites may say: we are not talking about Yahawashi, about Christ; our anger is towards you, we slander you. But Christ said: “Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.” Whatever you do to these men, you do unto him.

So when you are angry with your brother without a cause, when you slander, hate, bite and devour, you are doing it to Christ, to Yahawashi, because Christ put us in this position. The servants the husbandmen beat and killed were his. The only difference is that we cannot do anything about it; we stay in the spirit and keep doing what God called us to do. Christ can do something about it. There is a lot he can do. That is why they call him the king of terror.

sense.text: “They perceived that he spake of them.” They knew right then: this negro is talking about us. Rightfully so.

“They feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.” They knew he was a prophet and still wanted to lay hands on him, because the words were cutting deep and they knew Christ would take away their place.

“And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.” The they that watched him are the Pharisees. They were always looking for accusations against Christ, following him to see whether he would slip up. Remember what Christ said: if they do it unto you, surely they have done it unto me. They follow you block to block, state to state, camp corner to camp corner; surely they did it unto Christ.

precepts.why: “And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.” The same watching: the scribes and Pharisees waiting for an accusation.

Christ had just finished condemning them: woe unto you lawyers, for you build the sepulchres of the prophets and your fathers killed them. “And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things”. They were trying to bring Christ out of the spirit, to get him to speak vehemently and say things he should not say. But Christ kept it spiritual, according to the Bible, the way we should.

“Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.” Trying to catch him slipping up in his speech. That was the Pharisees, and the same Pharisees are here today in 2026.

“And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words”. We might have a few of them up in here, in our Atlanta, New York and Mississippi congregations. We know you are there, biding your time. “That so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.”

sense.text: “Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem”. Christ was travelling, and they came from Jerusalem, following him around from place to place. They follow us from state to state, and soon it will be country to country. Do not be shocked.

precepts.why: “And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub”. The scribes came down from Jerusalem: they had started to follow Christ from region to region.
“Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.” They came from Jerusalem, following him. The same thing done yesterday is being done this very day.

sense.text:
“For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.” Envy and hatred are real, brothers. It is a strong demon. It was written all over their faces and their spirit; they could not hide it. Even a heathen could see it.

Do we see that today? Yes. Heathens make videos sitting down with other heathens: this camp believes this, that camp believes that; this camp is worldwide, an organized movement, global, not domestic; and this camp with the studs on, looking like the Legion of Doom from the WWF, hates these men in purple. Even the heathen know it. That is a damn shame.

precepts.why: “For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.” Pilate, a heathen, could see it: it was for envy.

sense.text:
We know it is the spirit of the Lord that allows us to move the way we move, opening up the doors of utterance for us: the spirit of the Most High working in the men of Israel United in Christ.

He healed one “blind, and dumb”, “insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.” When the Pharisees heard and saw miracles no man on earth could do at that time but Christ, “they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.” They accused the Holy Spirit’s work of being satanic, the same way they accuse our work of being satanic: oh, they are going to Africa raping little boys. The slander we hear will blow your mind. They are denying the power thereof, the Holy Spirit.

“But the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.” That is what the Pharisees were doing: speaking out against the Holy Ghost, against the miracles Christ was doing. They speak out against the great things we are doing in Israel United in Christ.

“Whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him”. Who was he speaking to? The Pharisees and scribes, and those same Pharisees and scribes are back on the earth today. So many will blaspheme the Holy Ghost, the works they see us doing in Israel United in Christ, and it will not be forgiven them.

This class was for edification. We have to make sure we do not roll in these spirits, that we do not have anger and hatred inside our hearts, and that the root of bitterness does not spring up and defile us. And we pray that these brothers from the other congregations repent too. If not, that is your lot, and you are doomed to die in your evil.

“But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.” You see the marvellous works in Israel United in Christ. You see the spirit of the Lord on the bishops to do what they do. You see the fruits of our spirit and of our work. Do not deny the truth because of your hatred, your envy, your malice.
“This wisdom descendeth not from above”: that spirit on you is not from the Lord. It “is earthly, sensual, devilish”: from the damn devil, Satan, your father.
“For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.” So clear that up: get the confusion out of your midst, out of your camps.
